items.title: 61427_Happy Caldwell oral history interview
items.q: Through Metcalf I started writing, through one of the fellows, one of the associate editors there at the time I was at the Rhythm Club.

ctx.x: Well, how did you get to start writing?
Through Metcalf I started writing, through one of the fellows, one of the associate editors there at the time I was at the Rhythm Club.
It's most unusual for a musician to write because most of them hate writing letters even, don't they? I mean --
